item.title: Hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship
item.description:
• Summary: An outbreak of hantavirus has been reported on a cruise ship, raising concerns about transmission in confined settings. The virus, which is spread through rodent droppings, can cause severe respiratory illness. Health authorities are investigating the source and implementing control measures to prevent further spread among passengers and crew.
